one_liner: Brook Lopez, a center, takes and makes threes at 36.6 percent while grabbing only 5.9 rebounds per 36 minutes.
three_things: 36.6 percent from three from the center spot -- the shot profile moved outside.
5.9 rebounds per 36 is low for the position, a direct consequence of that spacing role.
Durability is the other story: 227 games in the window.
context_note: Per-36-minute rates over a 3-season sample (seasons_played: 3), not per-game and not full-career figures. The manifest is descriptive_only: no adjustment for opponent, teammates, role, or shot difficulty, and a career_min_minutes>=800 inclusion floor applies. Games and minutes measure availability, not how well those minutes were used.
